articleTitle: Improved CMOS Inverter Characteristics of Junctionless FinFETs using Gaussian Doping
publicationTitle: 2021 Third International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: In this paper, the CMOS characteristics of Trigate Junctionless FinFETs has been improved using Gaussian doping. The proposed device shows better device electrical characteristics of potential distribution, threshold voltage and drive current of Trigate Gaussian doped Junctionless FinFETs than the uniform doping. The potential distribution has been developed from two-dimensional poisons equation using variable separation method. Further, the Gaussian doping reduces the short channel effects of subthreshold swing and Drain Induced Barrier Lowering (DIBL). The results show the better device characteristics of Trigate Junctionless FinFETs using Gaussian doping.

articleTitle: An Image Hiding Algorithm based on Bit Plane and Two-Dimensional Code
publicationTitle: 2021 Third International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: An image hiding algorithm based on bit plane and two-dimensional code is proposed in this paper. The main characteristic of information hiding is to use the information redundant data of the existing image, to embed the information into these redundant data by the information hiding algorithm, or to partially replace redundant information with information to be embedded to achieve a visual invisible purpose. We first analyze the color index usage frequency of the block index matrix in the algorithm, and calculate the distance between the color of the block index matrix with only one color and the other color in the palette that is closest to the color. Then, the QR model and the compression model are applied to improve the efficiency. We compare the proposed model with the stateof-the-art models.

articleTitle: Maximum Entropy Principle based Document Ranking with Term Selection Analysis for Cross-Lingual Information Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2021 Third International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Retrieval of proper information from the collection of available data on Internet in a cross-lingual platform is a tedious task. For the retrieval of information, the user specifies the required data in the way of query. In some cases, the query could not clearly define the required information specifically owing to the ambiguities and is solved by the use of Google translator. This paper presents a new Tamil-English cross lingual information retrieval (CLIR) where the queries in Tamil language are used to retrieve related documents from English language. The proposed model uses Maximum Entropy Principle based Document Ranking with Term Selection Analysis (MEPDR-TSA) for CLIR. The presented MEPDR model distributes the term frequency weights between the documents subjected to a provided query. In TSA, the term selection value is used to select the retrieved documents from each query. In addition, Google translator is used to translating the query into English and then again translate the retrieved English documents into Tamil language. The performance of the MEPDR-TSA model has been tested against several Tamil language based queries and the results are investigated interms of precision, recall, and F-score.

articleTitle: VLSI Implementation of Error Detection and Correction Codes for Space Engineering
publicationTitle: 2021 Third International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: On behalf of technology scaling, on-chip memories in a die undergoes bit errors because of single events or multiple cell upsets by the ecological factors such as cosmic radiation, alpha, neutron particles or due to maximum temperature in space, leads to data corruption. Error detection and correction techniques (ECC) recognize and rectify the corrupted data over communication channel. In this paper, an advanced error correction 2-dimensional code based on divide-symbol is proposed to weaken radiation-induced MCUs in memory for space applications. For encoding data bits, diagonal bits, parity bits and check bits were analyzed by XOR operation. To recover the data, again XOR operation was performed between the encoded bits and the recalculated encoded bits. After analyzing, verification, selection and correction process takes place. The proposed scheme was simulated and synthesized using Xilinx Vivado implemented in Verilog HDL. Compared with the well known existing methods, this encoding-decoding process consumes low power and occupies minimum area and delay.

articleTitle: Medicine Parameters Monitoring Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2021 Third International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: This paper presents an electronic device to monitor the medical goods during their exportation to overseas. During the exportation of medical goods for overseas, it is necessary to ensure that whether the medicines will be maintained in the healthy surrounding or not to prevent the medicines from lack of quality. This problem can be overcome by monitoring the temperature, humidity and location of the medical good containers by using sensors, actuators and Internet of Things [IoT]. The constant supply of power for a long time to the device and the collection of data during the absence of network are also some of the important aspects discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: Impact of Distance Measures in Shepards Interpolation Algorithm on Natural Images Corrupted by Outliers
publicationTitle: 2021 Third International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: The impact of Distance Measures in an Interpolation Algorithm on Natural images corrupted by Outliers is proposed. The Adaptive Inverse Distance Interpolation (Shepards algorithm) is modified with various distances for increasing distances. The Window size increases adaptively when three non noisy pixels does not exist in the current processing window. It was found that L1 Norm is robust than L2 Norm on Natural images corrupted by high density outliers noise. The algorithm requires a minimum of three non noisy pixels to perform L1 norm based Sheppard algorithm. Exhaustive testing were done on images of standard Database The use of L1 Norm based as distance measure between the processed pixel and non noisy pixel had a better impact on the performance of the algorithm in the presence of outliers with information preservation.

articleTitle: Maximum Geographical Coverage Deployment of Ambulances using Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 Third International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Most of the networks have one common problem, namely, to find the best locations to place the nodes. One solution to this is random deployment. This research work demonstrates how random deployment can be used to get the final coordinates of ambulances placement where the lifetime of network increases with maximum area coverage. Genetic Algorithm is reviewed to get the working criteria of it and after that it is implemented to get the result outcomes with roper analysis. The main concern of doing this research is to develop a technique that can provide the benefit to small network those cannot afford high costs to deploy the sensors. Main focus of this paper is on the deployment of 50 nodes only those would definitely be increased in future for hundreds of the nodes. In this research, nodes act as an ambulance those are required to deploy in a specific area to get the maximum coverage of area in the situation of an emergency.

articleTitle: PIC Controlled Hardware Model Realization for Frequency Regulation in Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2021 Third International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Frequency regulation in power plants is the need of the hour to maintain power system reliability. Generation and load demand are continuously monitored and the governor system of turbine is operated to keep the frequency within the desirable limit. In the proposed scheme, a hardware model is realized which consists of separate control for real power and reactive power to maintain a constant frequency. In the existing power plants, complete opening and closing of valves are done when the frequency exceeds the tolerance limit. This results in huge stresses on turbine blades. The proposed valve control mitigates the turbine blade stresses by partially opening and closing the valves even when there is a slight change in frequency. The proposed frequency regulation eliminates the steady state error through integral action. The complexity of gate control circuitry in the existing system for reactive power control is also eliminated by a separate reactive power control circuitry comprising of an operational amplifier and a current amplifier. The proposed system performs better than the existing method in thermal power plants.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of DWT based Multiple Input Multiple Output OFDM for Internet Telephony Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 Third International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Digital communication plays a vital role in transmitting and receiving the information. With the advent of advancements in telecommunications, requirement of high data rate is in evident in Digital communication for the transmission of the signal. The information which has to be transmitted over a long distance needed to be error free while receiving in order to obtain the quality of the information. Emphasizing on the high data rate and also error free requirements, the role of Multiple Input Multiple Output and Wavelet as a combination makes progress towards high extent in achieving successful transmission. The proposed work emphasizes on the application of Discrete wavelet transform for filtering the Quadrature Amplitude modulated wave for the internet telephonic communication where the digital communication plays a major role. This proposed work purely concentrates on the digital communication part of the internet telephony communications. Stein's Unbiased Risk Estimate is used to obtain the information samples with soft thresholding. The Bit to Error rate performance is measured for various modulation order and the simulated results are shown and also the values of the Bit to Error rate are tabulated.

articleTitle: Colour Feature Analysis for Gender Prediction using Image Processing and Soft Computing Techniques
publicationTitle: 2021 Third International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Soft computing techniques in clustering or classification area have made an amount of progress in last decade or two. Use of camera for image capturing and using it for analysis of any given task with the help of soft computational approach itself gained attraction of most of the researchers. Classification being one of the prime areas of application mostly utilized in majority of industrial, monitoring, security applications. This research work focusing on usage of human hand dorsal portion for gender predication or classification with the help colour feature of an image. An image feature colour of a hand dorsal part can be analyzed in better way for classification or clustering of an image in to two gender class as male or female. The analysis using colour feature is carried out on colour image with the help of Convolutional Neural Network and with the help of image parameters such as pixel values, pixel averaging, channel based specific analyzer etc. Further the results obtained in colour analysis are been merged with a study of texture analysis on same dorsal portion of hand has been judged to obtain desired clustering.

articleTitle: Deep Learning based Framework for Text Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 Third International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: At present, object detection is estimated as a core assignment in the province of computer vision. Strategies for text detection dependent on deep learning have been applied in variety of fields, like smart transportation systems and self-sufficient driving system. In recent times deep learning based strategies used for localization of text have acquired cheerful results with respect to diverse datasets, but, they typically fall behind when presented to precarious circumstance. Still there is a challenge among speed and precision for text discovery. Customarily for text detection generally the two phase detectors like Faster-RCNN, Fast-RCNN and R-CNN were investigated. In this work, a deep learning based framework for detecting text in scene pictures is proposed. Proposed framework is based on one stage object detection system identified as YOLOv5 which is nearly quicker and precise, difference to existing object detectors. It gives quick and exact identification of text from basic scene pictures. Analyses performed on condition of craftsmanship datasets including ICDAR 2013, ICDAR 2015, ICDAR 2003, SVT, MSRA-TD-500 show that the proposed framework essentially performs better aside from ICDAR2015, contrast with existing strategies regarding rightness. Proposed framework obtains optimum results for ICDAR2013 dataset. The size of model produced through our framework is small.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Spatial Modulation with Different Input Modalities
publicationTitle: 2021 Third International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: In this era of increasing data users, error free transmission and overcoming the shortcomings of limited bandwidth are the current challenges in increasing the spectral efficiency. In order to increase the data rate with constrained bandwidth, a technique called Spatial Modulation (SM) is used to transmit information with the help of spatial location of source. This study aims to model an end-to-end reliable communication system using SM and evaluate its performance in transmission and reception of different forms of data, viz. image, audio and text. The analysis is carried out with various Quadrature Amplitude Modulation (QAM) schemes and antenna numbers. Rayleigh fading channel is assumed as the channel model with Signal to Noise Ratio (SNR) range between 0-24dB. Further the performance is evaluated using bit error ratio (BER) and Mean square Error (MSE).

articleTitle: Intelligent Online Political Education Model of Colleges based on Multimedia and Complex Information Transmission
publicationTitle: 2021 Third International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Intelligent online political education model of the colleges based on sensitive multimedia and complex information transmission is well designed and studied in this paper. The connection between humans and machines will soon transition from the general connection of information to the connection of simulated emotions, especially the anthropomorphic functions of machines are booming, making machines use the artificial intelligence to meet the needs of human emotional connection will become a future development trend. Both theory and practice prove that the availability of information system will affect the user's emotion, find out the problem of information system availability, and inspired by this, the paper proposes the novel multimedia asystem and consider the complex scenario. The experiment has proven the performance.

articleTitle: Layout Optimization of Landscape Architecture based on Intelligent Visual Scene Recognition and Saliency Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 Third International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Layout optimization of the landscape architecture based on intelligent visual scene recognition and saliency analysis is studied in this article. Among the many scenaiios, the core behavior analysis of crowd-intensive scenarios in the public areas is particularly important. This article considers the mentioned scenario for general testing. The multi-level parallel processor receives the core image signal from the retina and processes the image information. Through the multi-level visual image feature extraction and image target detection, the learning, memory and recognition functions of the visual information are completed. Hence, consider this technique novelty to apply into the core layout optimization of the landscape. The simulation results have proven the effectiveness.

articleTitle: Efficient Data Transmission Model for Internet of Things Application
publicationTitle: 2021 Third International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: WSN plays a very important role for provisioning Internet-of-things (IoT) applications. The IoT enabled sensor network (IoT-SN) is composed of large number of battery powered sensor devices connected to IoT gateways. These sensor device are put forth in hazardous location for carrying out different operation such as sensing and transmitting. Preserving battery of sensor device is very critical. Existing data transmission model predominately focused on reducing energy consumption of device. However, modern application requires energy efficiency with low latency service delivery. Enhancing lifetime performance and network reliability for collecting sensed data is the major objective of IoT enabled sensor network(IoTSN).The work focuses on cluster-Head to reduce the energy consumption and to increase the lifetime of network. Thus, this paper present multi-objective metric for designing efficient data transmission model for IoT-SN. Experiment result shows EDT model is efficient increasing lifetime of network with less latencies.

articleTitle: Modified Distance Protection for Series Compensated (SC) Overhead Lines
publicationTitle: 2021 Third International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: This article shows the conceptual and modeling applicability of the modified distance relay for the transmission system integrating this same Series Compensator (SCs) associated at the midpoint. The malfunction of protective relays for the transmission network with SCs at multiple places has been analyzed. Simulation results demonstrate that the underreach and over-reach are somewhat more intense with SCs at the mid-point of the network. To alleviate the error of protective relays, the reconfigured methodology has been formulated based on a recursive numerical simulation. The simulation is conducted with the altered arrangement that has been outperformed compared to a traditional scheme. Electromagnetic Transient Program (EMTP) computations on two machine systems are being used to support the claim.

articleTitle: Electromagnetics and Transmission Line for the Better Design of Antenna : Electromagnetics study
publicationTitle: 2021 Third International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: In general, the term “Antenna” is derived from the latin word, which means something that is used for transmitting and retrieving both the messages and signals. The proposed research work aims to design one such system in our study, to aid the future of communication technologies. This research work has performed an in-depth analysis of the electromagnetics study.
